name: HN snapshot completeness (id ranges); title-prefix classification
threshold: every 1M-id block in the window's comment id range: distinct ids / id span >= 0.99; ambiguous Ask/Show titles < 1% of stories
notes: HN ids are allocated sequentially to every item type, so distinct ids over the span measure what the dump is missing. Ask HN = title starting 'Ask HN' (case-insensitive); 'Ask YC' and titles with 'Ask HN' later in the title stay in link/text_other; Ask HN posts with a url stay Ask HN.
